rules.title: Sufficient identifiers and attributable evidence
rules.description: The claim must contain stable identifiers and its evidence must be directly attributable and internally consistent.
rules.clause_text: The claim must include sufficient identifiers to associate supporting evidence.

rules.title: Approved contract rate
rules.description: Each supported outcome must be billed at the fixed amount stated in the approved order form.

rules.title: Billing period
rules.description: The outcome must close inside the invoice billing period.
rules.clause_text: The outcome must occur during the invoice billing period.

rules.title: No same-intent recontact
rules.description: No same-intent customer contact may occur within seven calendar days after closure.
rules.clause_text: A resolution is not billable when the customer recontacts support for the same intent within seven calendar days.

rules.title: No human completion
rules.description: No human completion or material correction may occur within 24 hours after closure.
rules.clause_text: A resolution is not billable when a human completes or materially corrects the promised work within 24 hours.

rules.title: Downstream action succeeds
rules.description: The promised downstream action must complete successfully within two hours.
rules.clause_text: A promised downstream action must complete successfully within two hours.

rules.title: Account and action match
rules.description: Operational evidence must match the expected customer account and promised action.
rules.clause_text: Evidence must match the expected customer account and promised action.

rules.title: Single attribution
rules.description: Among otherwise-payable claims, only the earliest outcome is billable for the same customer and normalized intent in a 24-hour window.
rules.clause_text: Among claims that pass R1, R2, R3, R5, R6, and R7, only the earliest outcome is billable for the same customer and normalized intent in a 24-hour attribution window.
